# Cryptad beta release notes template

This template is safe for public release. Keep it digest-only and summary-only. Do not include
private insert URIs, keys, tokens, authorization headers, cookies, form passwords, raw support
bundles, raw app data, raw fetched content, raw feed bodies, raw profile documents, raw trust
statements, raw social messages, raw request or response bodies, app-data backups, or absolute local
paths.

## Redaction confirmation

- Public release notes contain no secrets, private URIs, tokens, raw support bundles, raw app data,
  raw content, request or response bodies, app-data backups, or absolute local paths.
- Security advisory sections contain public-safe summaries only and keep exploit details in the
  private security workflow.
